subject: MMPBSA.py reports ESCF for receptor when only ligand is chosen as QM region

messages.author: CA Mattelaer
messages.body:
Dear all
When doing a QM/MM-GBSA analysis, MMPBSA.py reports ESCF for the
receptor part of the analysis even when only selecting the ligand as QM
region. This is unexpected behaviour.
Based on the value of ESCF and comparison of output files of receptor
and complex, MMPBSA.py seems to just take the line where it expects ESCF
(in this case CMAP value) without checking if it has to look for ESCF in
the first place. This seems like a bug to me.
Kind regards
Charles-Alexandre Mattelaer
